input: Find overnight, sleepaway and residential summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Black Mountain, Swannanoa, Montreat and Old Fort, NC. Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Montreat College 2026 summer immersion residential high school

candidates.name: Camp Rockmont
candidates.note: Christian overnight camp for boys ages 7–17; 2027 dates announced.

candidates.name: Camp Merri-Mac
candidates.note: Girls’ Christian sleepaway camp for grades 1–11; 2027 sessions run June–August.

candidates.name: Ridgecrest Summer Camps
candidates.note: Runs Camp Ridgecrest for Boys and Camp Crestridge for Girls; two-week Christian overnight sessions in 2027.

candidates.name: Higher Ground Adventures
candidates.note: Week-long Christian overnight adventure camp for teens, with outdoor activities and worship.

candidates.name: Warren Wilson College
candidates.note: Swannanoa Gathering offers residential music workshops and a children’s program for ages 6–12; minors require an accompanying adult.

candidates.name: Montreat Conference Center
candidates.note: Week-long summer youth conferences combine study, worship and recreation; 2027 conferences announced.

candidates.name: Montreat College
candidates.note: Residential COMPASS academic program for rising sophomores through incoming college freshmen, June 20–24, 2027; also summer sports camps.

candidates.name: Passport, Inc.
candidates.note: PASSPORTkids residential church-group camps at Montreat, with lodging in the Assembly Inn and guest lodges; 2026 and 2027 programs found.

candidates.name: Presbyterian Association of Musicians
candidates.note: Intergenerational Worship & Music Conference includes children and youth programming and lodging; two summer 2027 weeks.

candidates.name: US Sports Camps
candidates.note: Nike baseball camp at Montreat College offered overnight participation in summer 2026; also runs softball camps there.

candidates.name: Camp Grier
candidates.note: Coed residential programs for rising grades 2–12; 2027 options include outdoor adventure, leadership, equestrian and mountain-bike camps.

candidates.name: Camp Timberlake
candidates.note: Boys’ Christian sleepaway camp for grades 1–11; summer campus is in Marion, not its Black Mountain winter office.

candidates.name: Lifeway
candidates.note: Runs residential FUGE youth camps and CentriKid children’s camps at Ridgecrest Conference Center; summer 2026 sessions verified.

candidates.name: Camp Lurecrest
candidates.note: Christian residential youth camp in Lake Lure; its five-night “Swannanoa” session is a session name, not the camp’s town.
